scope_notes: The published selected OnceNet encoder has42480parameters and was trained on mathematical data. The separate Bering model has1566756parameters and used real unlabeled acoustic pretraining.
Frozen experimental runners retain original hash-bound absolute paths and closed-run guards. They are archival implementations, not automatic portable rerun commands.
Original official fixture PNGs are excluded. Restore files from their recorded public URLs/hashes before invoking full inference-bundle verification or query wrappers.
The newest remote whale code snapshot is separate from the CPU-canonical inference snapshot; it is not silently merged or used to change frozen results.
No repository license grant was found; existing attribution and third-party terms remain applicable.
